Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused my request because the Gateway has no credentials configured for it, so nothing is scheduled yet and no digest will post on Monday 19 October unless that's fixed.

I checked the channels you asked about. #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest can draw on both without exposing anything to new people. The digest will leave out finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) and finance documents, and it won't use direct messages or other channels.

To get it running, someone with Gateway access needs to configure the scheduler's credentials (`gateway.auth` in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`, or pair this device). Once that's done, I can set up the Monday 08:00 Chicago-time job and do a test run. Until then, I can post a digest by hand on any Monday if you ask me.
